_README: Per-endpoint knowledge the OpenAPI schema cannot carry.
base          parameters pinned on every probe for this endpoint
limit         page size for the baseline (smaller = faster sweep)
values        probe values for a parameter the schema leaves open
search_probe  a substring known to match something real
scope         response fields a filter MUST NOT move.
`scope` is the part worth maintaining. A filter that narrows the
wrong half of a row is invisible to row counts and to timings -- the
totals simply come back wrong, and nobody notices for weeks. Naming
the frozen fields turns that into a test.
